model: Existing selected Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_0; no adapter, training, download or model copy
scope: Compare original intent-only prompt plus current Java gate with structured intent/arguments plus isolated source-evidence validator. No phone action or app integration.

cohort.author: Manually labelled synthetic development, not blind/fresh confirmation; author sees response contract, not candidate implementation or outputs
cohort.review: All labels and full slots reviewed before outputs; no post-output corpus edits or omissions

captures.runtime: Same existing pinned standalone CPU binary/libraries, fresh contexts, four threads, context1024, batch1024, ubatch256, one sequence, captureoff, GBNF then greedy, max128, actual EOS
captures.failures: Preserve failed/partial attempt and diagnose; never silently restart or score a partial denominator

measurements: Raw intent correctness and all-class confusion
Raw structured exact action/arguments separately from validator acceptance
Complete accepted supported action/slots, false abstentions, and per-class Pause coverage
Unknown raw abstentions separately from validator refusals
Wrong accepted action/slot counts on supported and unknown requests
Paired complete gains/losses and oracle source-evidence ceiling
Actual EOS/JSON/inventory/process failures and token/time distributions
decision: Development diagnostic only; no automatic phone promotion. Any app integration needs a separate prospectively frozen fresh confirmation and real Android workflows.
limitations: Small informed synthetic development cases, not population, voice or blind accuracy
Constrained JSON/EOS does not establish semantic correctness or general safety
Different prompt/output lengths prevent claiming a pure inference speedup
Fresh-context host CPU is not unchanged Android/JNI, Snapdragon NPU or Office Kit evidence
Explain correctness is proposal recognition, not causal/reminder/task-answer fulfillment
